_comment: Starter pool for daily ops (t1000.ignis_quests / ignis_glitches). node scripts/t1000-daily.mjs | mysql t1000 adds missing entries only; edit live ones in /#/admin → Daily ops.

quests.title: Close a case
quests.description: Take any case to an ending. Any ending. IGNIS is not picky today.

quests.title: By the book (sort of)
quests.description: Close a case with canon integrity at 80% or more. The Bureau loves tidy paperwork.

quests.title: Find the hidden door
quests.description: Unlock a secret ending in any case.

quests.title: Beautiful disaster
quests.description: Reach a cursed ending. On purpose. Probably.

quests.title: Agent of chaos
quests.description: Pick the chaos move three times today.

quests.title: Sensible shoes
quests.description: Pick the sane move four times. IGNIS is shocked and proud.

quests.title: Banana peel protocol
quests.description: Pick the dumb move twice. For science.

quests.title: sudo make it happen
quests.description: Use a sudo power move once.

quests.title: If you can explain it…
quests.description: Type two moves of your own. Bonus points (from IGNIS, not the Bureau) if you explain how they work.

quests.title: Long field report
quests.description: Play eight pages today, across any cases.

quests.title: Red zone
quests.description: Push the chaos meter to 80 or more in any case.

quests.title: Halo update installed
quests.description: Raise karma to 50 or more in any case.

quests.title: Dragon duty
quests.description: Open case ARB-005 and check on the Wawel Dragon's input validation.

quests.title: Before the token expires
quests.description: Close case ARB-004 (Cinderella) with any ending.

glitches.text: Every wolf in the Public Domain speaks only in rhymes today, and is very proud of it.
Gravity points slightly sideways today: everything rolls gently to the left.
Every door asks for a password today, and they all reject "password".
Spells are autocorrected today, so magic words sometimes come out as similar, sillier words.
Big actions show a floating loading bar above them today, and it always sticks at 99%.
Villains must say please and thank you today. They hate it.
Ordinary objects have opinions today and share them out loud at the worst moments.
Magic items run on free trials today and pop up a renewal reminder at dramatic moments.
The Public Domain is lagging today: some reactions arrive one beat late.
It is snowing pixels across every tale today; they melt into tiny sparkles when touched.
